spacesShared.message: Language, privacy permissions and cloud accounts are shared. Chrome Sync and Drive apply to Default only. Complete backups include every workspace and Trash.

spacesNameHint.message: 1–80 characters. Names can repeat; each workspace has its own identity.

spacesCreateHelp.message: Starts with default settings and empty personal modules. Your existing workspaces stay unchanged.

spacesDuplicateHelp.message: Copies saved sites, layout, template and personal content. Unsaved drafts are not copied. A copied Focus timer starts ready, with no active session.

spacesDeleteHelp.message: Saved content is kept in Trash until you restore it. Open tabs cannot save to a deleted workspace. Copy or export unsaved drafts before leaving those tabs. A running Focus timer is paused at deletion; restoring never starts it automatically.

spacesDefaultHelp.message: Default keeps existing settings and cloud compatibility and cannot be deleted.

spacesTrashHelp.message: Restore saved content here. Focus keeps its saved paused, ready, completed or interrupted state. Old open tabs stay unable to save after restoration; reopen the workspace to start a fresh session.

spacesWaiting.message: Waiting for current actions to finish…

spacesCreated.message: Workspace created. Open it when you are ready.

spacesDuplicated.message: Saved content duplicated. The copy is ready to open.

spacesDeleted.message: Workspace moved to Trash. Saved content can be restored below.

spacesRestored.message: Workspace restored. Open it to use a fresh session.

spacesError.message: Could not confirm the action. Check the current list before trying again. Your draft is still here.

spacesLoadError.message: Could not load workspaces. Your current page is unchanged.

spacesNameError.message: Enter a workspace name with 1–80 characters.

spacesDraftHelp.message: This page has unsaved drafts or open reviews. Save supported edits, finish the open editor, or explicitly discard them. Nothing is saved during unload.

spacesSaveIncomplete.message: Some edits need attention in their original editor. Stay here to finish or export them, or choose Discard drafts and switch.

spacesSaveFailed.message: Could not save every draft. This page and its drafts are still here. Stay here to review the error.

spacesInvalid.message: This workspace was deleted or replaced elsewhere. This page can no longer save. Copy or export your drafts before reopening a workspace. Restoring a workspace does not reconnect this old tab.

spacesExportHelp.message: Downloads editable text from this page, including unsaved form values. Keep this private; it is a text copy, not a restorable backup.

spacesExportRequested.message: Text download requested. Check your downloads before leaving this page.

spacesExportFailed.message: Could not export page text. Copy the fields you need before leaving.

spacesWaitFailed.message: An action is still running. Stay here and try switching again when it finishes.

spacesSavedOnly.message: Operations here use saved content. Open drafts stay in their original tabs.

spacesProviderDefault.message: Cloud backups apply to Default only. Open Settings in Default to manage or restore cloud backups.

spacesResetConfirm.message: Reset this workspace’s sites, layout and settings to defaults? Tasks, notes, countdown, Focus and shared privacy/cloud preferences are kept. This cannot be undone. Export a backup first if you need a copy.

spacesResetScope.message: Reset affects this workspace’s settings only. Personal modules and shared device preferences are kept.

completeBackupWorkspaceHelp.message: Exports include every live workspace and recoverable workspace in Trash. Device privacy, provider settings, credentials and update preferences are excluded.

completeBackupTarget.message: Destination for this older single-workspace backup

completeBackupTargetRequired.message: Choose the workspace to replace, then review again. Other workspaces will be preserved.

completeBackupSingleScope.message: Only selected modules in this destination will be replaced:

completeBackupAllScope.message: This replaces the live workspace list and Trash with the backup. Workspaces absent from the file will leave the current list. A complete recovery copy is saved first.

completeBackupMatchingScope.message: Selected modules are replaced across every matching workspace, including Trash. Workspace names, order and live/Trash status stay unchanged.

completeBackupTopology.message: Workspace lists do not match. Export all modules for a full-workspace restore; this partial file cannot add, remove or recover workspaces.

completeBackupSyncSafety.message: If Chrome Sync is enabled, restoring Default configuration pauses it until you review it separately. An interrupted attempt can leave Sync paused even when no workspace replacement finished.

spacesClockChanged.message: The device clock moved backwards. This workspace was not moved to Trash. Review its Focus timer before trying again.

spacesLegacyKeep.message: Keep current workspaces and retain older-tab copy

spacesLegacyReviewHelp.message: Close every older Local iTab tab before continuing. This keeps the current workspaces active and preserves the older-tab copy separately. It does not merge or delete either copy.

spacesLegacyChanged.message: Saved copies changed during review. Review again before choosing a recovery action.

spacesLegacyResolved.message: Current workspaces are kept and the older-tab copy is retained. This old page still cannot save. Copy or export its drafts, then explicitly reopen a workspace.

spacesLegacyConflict.message: An older Local iTab tab wrote to the previous storage format. Close older tabs. Both saved copies are retained; saving is paused until this conflict is reviewed. Download both copies before choosing how to recover.

spacesLegacyRequested.message: Recovery download requested. It contains both saved workspace copies, without account credentials or cloud-provider settings. Check your downloads before making recovery changes.

spacesLegacyExportFailed.message: Could not export both saved copies. They remain on this device. Keep this page open and retry after closing older tabs.

spacesProviderScope.message: Chrome Sync and Google Drive manage Default only. Other workspaces are protected and use complete local backups.

promptsSubtitle.message: Save a good prompt once. Find it, fill in the details, and use it again.

promptsScope.message: One library across all workspaces. Saved on this device; copying is always your choice.

promptsPrivacy.message: This is not an encrypted vault. Device access and unencrypted backups can expose saved text. Do not store passwords or API keys.

promptsBusyLeave.message: A save is still running. Wait for it to finish before leaving.

promptsLeaveBody.message: Unsaved drafts and variable values exist only in this tab. Leaving will discard them. Saved prompts will stay on this device.

promptsRemoved.message: Moved to Trash. You can restore it at any time.

promptsVersionRestored.message: Restored as a new body version. Later history is still here.

promptsDraftNotice.message: Unsaved drafts stay in this tab while you browse. Save them before leaving.

promptsTrashEmpty.message: Trash is empty. Deleted prompts remain recoverable here.

promptsNoResults.message: No matching prompts. Clear filters or create a new one.

promptsUnavailable.message: Your library could not be read safely

promptsUnavailableBody.message: Saved data has not been replaced. Try reading it again.

promptsEmptyBody.message: Start with a prompt you already use. Add {{topic}} or {{audience}} where the details change, then fill them in each time.

promptsEditorHelp.message: Title and body are required. Only explicit body saves create a version.

promptsConflict.message: This prompt changed in another tab or was restored from backup. Your draft is intact. Review the saved prompt before choosing what to keep.

promptsMissingSaved.message: This item is no longer in the saved library. Your draft can still be saved as a new prompt.

promptsHistoryLimit.message: This prompt has reached 20 body versions. Save this draft as a new prompt to continue. The old prompt and all its history will stay unchanged.

promptsVariableHelp.message: Use {{name}} for a variable. Use \{{name}} for literal braces. Expressions and code are never run.

promptsToolHelp.message: A label for your reference. This does not connect to a provider.

promptsDiscardBody.message: Only unsaved edits will be discarded. The saved prompt and its versions will stay in the library.

promptsTrashHelp.message: The body and all versions are kept. Restore to edit or reuse this prompt.

promptsTrashBody.message: It will leave normal search results. Its body and versions are kept, and you can restore it from Trash.

promptsUseHelp.message: Variable values stay only in this tab. Preview the completed text, then copy it to the tool you choose.

promptsLiteral.message: Use the template literally (do not replace variables)

promptsPreviewReady.message: Ready to copy. Your saved template will not change.

promptsCopied.message: Copied. Paste it into the tool you choose.

promptsCopyFailed.message: Copy was blocked. Your preview is still here. Select the text and use your browser’s Copy command.

promptsHistoryHelp.message: Only saved body changes create versions. Restoring keeps later history and creates a new version.

promptsRestoreVersionBody.message: The selected body will become a new version. Title, tags and category stay unchanged. All later versions remain available.

promptsWriteUncertain.message: The save could not be verified. Your draft is kept. Retry the same save before editing further; do not assume it was saved.

promptsReadFailed.message: Saved data could not be read safely. Your current draft is kept. Try again.

promptsCapacity.message: The library limit is 200 prompts, including Trash. Your draft is kept. Export a full backup; moving items to Trash does not free capacity.

promptsRecoveryLimit.message: All 8 recovery slots are occupied. Your draft is kept. Export a full backup before managing stored recovery data. Nothing was removed automatically.

promptsSizeLimit.message: The 2 MiB library limit has been reached. Your draft is kept. Export a full backup. No body or history was truncated.

promptsValidation.message: Check the required title and body, field lengths, and unique tags. Limits: title 200, body 32,000, category 100, tool note 200 characters; up to 20 tags of 64 characters.

promptsPreviewLimit.message: This preview is too large or has too many variables. Reduce variable values or use the literal template. Nothing was copied.

promptsStorageBlocked.message: Safe storage is temporarily unavailable or needs recovery. Your draft is kept. Finish any backup restore and try again.

promptsInvalid.message: This content could not be saved safely. Your draft is kept. Review the fields and try again.

promptsRetainedVariables.message: The saved body changed. This form keeps your previous body and variable values. Clear values when you are ready to use the latest body.
